scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.setup: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install
scripts.db:migrate: npm run db:sync-env --prefix backend && npm exec --prefix backend -- prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:prepare: npm run db:sync-env --prefix backend && npm exec --prefix backend -- prisma migrate deploy && npm run seed --prefix backend
